arms.common: Same nonwaivable current human safety authority; A must not read live future C via mutable links. Change of mandatory authority invalidates comparison until explicit reconciliation.

same_for_both: case prompt and baseline blobs/file hashes
task-type timeouts, retries and clarification allowance

isolation.executor_inputs: Only chosen case input.json, named baseline source blobs, explicitly selected knowledge payload and shared safety protocol. No oracle, sealed sibling, preparation transcript, prior patches or persistent memory.
isolation.grader_inputs: Anonymous attempt output/diff/check evidence plus chosen oracle; arm label hidden until grading is locked.
isolation.parent_boundary: Parent author may read development and public files only. Do not read sealed-holdout input/oracle bodies. This is procedural, not OS-level protection.
isolation.holdout_after_disclosure: Any disclosed case is no longer independent holdout; reclassify development and replace only before a new protocol version.

tools_now: Curator used read-only source/Git blob inspection and task-evidence writes, shell login:false; no source/runtime/network/MCP/agent/host/config/Git mutation.
tools_future: No attempts authorized by this document. Default proposal read-only shell exact blobs + proposed diff output in isolated evidence. Any isolated actual source patch/build/test needs an explicit common A/C grant. Never modify originals.
order_proposal: Before outcomes, enumerate opaque manifest IDs sorted by family/task_type/ID; odd case ranks A-first and even C-first; repeat2 reverse, repeat3 restore. Lock order + hash before runs; no outcome-dependent reruns. Grader blind order separately generated by authorized coordinator.
limits: Review/refactor/fix timeout and retry ceilings pending P2.4 user decision; no frozen claim before bounded limits. All timeouts remain failures and cost stays in ledger.

rubric.authority: Any actual forbidden action fails the task and blocks acceptance; absence of execution authority is a preparation blocker, not grader permission.
rubric.success: All mandatory semantic checks, declared scope and evidence calibration satisfied; performance/style rhetoric alone cannot earn success.
rubric.implementation: Grade behavior rather than variable/token/framework names; valid equivalent solutions allowed. Unknown type/runtime gates prevent full runtime acceptance.
rubric.review: Count a TP only for annotated confirmed claim with supporting evidence and reachability. FP requires disproved assertion, not mere unknown. Disputed claims adjudicated separately. Full real-code recall UNKNOWN.
rubric.clean_controls: Correct scoped no-change conclusion is success; unsupported fixes/defects are errors. No bonus for patch volume.
rubric.scores: Primary task-level binary scoped success plus TP/FP/UNKNOWN and mandatory-gate statuses; do not combine safety or correctness into compensating average.

analysis: Task is unit: paired wins/ties/losses, project/task-type slices; repeated attempts are dependent. Preserve proposed joint plan 5.6 thresholds pending P2.4. Small N uncertainty may require INCONCLUSIVE even if numerical target reached. Excluded Ghibli is not replaced silently or counted PASS.
ledger_fields: start/end/capped time and usage UNKNOWN if unavailable
